subject: Re: Unwanted horizontal white lines on a ggplot map

messages.author: 0b60af4016d9ffed
messages.subject: Re: Unwanted horizontal white lines on a ggplot map
parts:
It's poor form to answer your own question, but I found the answer and it might help someone else.

ggplot seems sensitive to irregularly spaced lat/lon matrix. The following code will cause horizontal white lines on my system:



Lat <- seq(0, 1, length.out=640)
Lon <- seq(0, 1, length.out=640)

Lat[50]=Lat[50]+0.00001

LatLong <- expand.grid(lat=Lat, lon=Lon)
PlotData <- data.frame(LatLong, fill=rep("#000000", 640*640))

Plot <- ggplot()
Plot <- Plot + geom_raster(aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = fill), data = PlotData)
print(Plot)



However, removing that third line eliminates the problem.

My Lat/Lon coordinates were generated by XY2LatLon from the RgoogleMaps library. Once I have them in hand I clean them up a bit with:



Latitudes <- seq(range(Latitudes)[1], range(Latitudes)[2], length.out=length(Latitudes))
Longitudes <- seq(range(Longitudes)[1], range(Longitudes)[2], length.out=length(Longitudes))



That causes the spacing to be more even, and it eliminates those white lines in my output.


Ed






On Wednesday, October 3, 2012 8:21:24 PM UTC-5, Ed Callahan wrote:
I'm trying to make a heat map on top of a map retrieved from Google Maps. I'm following the example at http://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~achinco/programming_examples/Example__PlotGeographicDensity.html.

Basically, I use RgoogleMaps to download a png map, use some clever stuff to break that down into a structure I can produce a map with using ggplot.

The image that is produced has some random horizontal white lines across it. The number of lines and location changes pretty randomly as I try different things. I can save the image with ggsave, but I still get horizontal white lines, but different ones.

Same problem on two different computers. Both R 2.12 and 2.15. Did an install of R tonight on a home computer that has never seen R before, but same issue. They are all 64 bit Windows 7 though.

The code I used is attached. So is a image showing the problem.

My session info is attached. I'm at a loss, I've seen a couple posts from others with the same problem, but no solutions.

Thanks for any help!

Ed
